title: NexGen technical dive — scheduling & attendees
text:
NexGen technical dive — scheduling & attendees

["From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@nexgenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NexGen technical dive — scheduling & attendees

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive (60–90m) with your infra/ML team.

Recap (short):
- Primary goal: move from POC to pilot — real-time inference for clinical triage, target 150–300 QPS at 256 token window.
- Data: PHI-sensitive; controls required (VPC/private deployment, KMS/HSM).
- Success metrics: 200ms median latency, <=5% inference error rate on clinical prompts, clear audit logs.

Proposal for the next session (TDX):
- Format: 75-minute working session (engineering-forward)
- Who: NexGen infra/ML lead + SRE, Redwood solutions engineer + infra lead + account exec
- Goals: walk architecture & traffic profile, validate model variants and quantization plan, confirm network/KMS requirements, run short perf/traffic scenarios and next steps for pilot sizing

Draft agenda (we can adjust):
1) 10m introductions & goals
2) 15m current infra and data flow (NexGen)
3) 20m Redwood runtime & deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private)
4) 20m perf targets, batching, caching approach + Q&A
5) 10m action items and next commitments

Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue Jul 6 — 10:00–11:15am PT
- Wed Jul 7 — 10:00–11:15am PT
- Thu Jul 8 — 1:00–2:15pm PT

Can you confirm: (a) which window works best, (b) the NexGen attendees we should invite (names + roles), and (c) any specific items you want on the agenda (SSO/SOC2, retention policies, tokenization strategy)?

I attached a short agenda draft (redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf) — happy to iterate. If easier, here's a 1-click poll: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/8f3b2c

Thanks — I can set the invite once you confirm the preferred slot and attendee list.

Best,
Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
", "From: Olivia Grant <olivia@nexgenhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexgenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexGen technical dive — scheduling & attendees

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear recap. Daniel and I reviewed the agenda; that's broadly what we'd expect. A couple quick notes and our attendee list below.

NexGen attendees (confirmed):
- Olivia Grant — Head of Partnerships (me)
- Daniel Park — CTO
- Priya Menon — ML Lead (priya.menon@nexgenhealth.com)
- Mateo Ruiz — Lead SRE (mateo.ruiz@nexgenhealth.com)

One ask: Priya will want a short section on model provenance + evaluation metrics and Mateo will want network/topology details for private deployment. Also — we need a high-level SOC2/KMS overview; can you confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC2 attestation and KMS integration notes during the call?

Conflicts on Jul 6 — we can't do morning that day. Best options for us are Jul 7 (morning) or Jul 8 (afternoon). I've attached our infra roster so Priya can be looped in with specifics.

Olivia

Attachment: nexgen-infra-roster.pdf
", "From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@nexgenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexgenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexGen technical dive — scheduling & attendees

Great — thanks for the attendee list, Olivia. Summary replies inline below and proposed next steps.

SOC2 / KMS: yes — we will have our security lead give a 10-minute overview of SOC2 scope and provide a follow-up doc with KMS/HSM integration patterns and sample network diagrams. Marissa (CC'd) will own the security primer.

Agenda updates: we will add a 10-minute block specifically for model provenance & eval (per Priya's ask) and ensure Mateo gets network diagrams in the follow-up.

Confirming two options that work for our team:
- Wed Jul 7 — 10:00–11:15am PT (preferred)
- Thu Jul 8 — 1:00–2:15pm PT

I'll pencil Jul 7 as the primary and Thu Jul 8 as a backup. If you confirm Jul 7 I'll send a calendar invite with conference details and a short runbook (what we'll ask you to have available).

Invite list I'll put on the invite:
- Olivia Grant (NexGen)
- Daniel Park (NexGen)
- Priya Menon (NexGen)
- Mateo Ruiz (NexGen)
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)
- Ben Carter (Redwood) — Account Exec
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Solutions/SE
- Laura Bennett (Redwood) — Infra lead (optional)

Attached: redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda + runbook stub).

Link to shared agenda doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XTDX-agenda-proposal

If Jul 7 works for you, I'll send the invite now.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
